purpose: Falsifiable operational hypotheses for the current single-host H3 reference; no universal optimality claim.
source_reference: v0.1.0; actual instrumented commit and file hashes must be recorded separately before execution

fixed_constraints.gpu: Full NVIDIA A100; record exact assigned form factor, memory, driver and topology
fixed_constraints.precision: Native BF16 backbone and LoRA with official FP32 exceptions; no silent quantization
fixed_constraints.content_identity: Hash the new prompt/reference manifest; record reference bytes, shapes and modality without publishing private assets
fixed_constraints.configuration: Freeze and record requested and effective attention, LoRA, steps, dimensions, frames and reference parameters before comparing timings
fixed_constraints.mainline: One bounded cloud session, one normal startup, finite batch, download verification, service cleanup and platform release
fixed_constraints.failure_policy: No until-pass loop. Record every failed attempt and explicit bounded recovery; reconcile unknown submissions by original identity.

unknown_rules: Missing event, identity, clock domain, budget or effective configuration is unknown, never implicit zero/success.
No actual pre-ready submission means H1 queue-while-loading is inconclusive.
No feasible independent work opportunity means H3 is inconclusive, not a scheduler failure or proof of overlap.
No response-loss injection means H6 covers only observed normal/incident paths.
No platform observation means resource release is unknown even if API became unreachable.
No complete matching FLOP/byte workload means whole-inference physical efficiency is unknown.

measurement.stage_clock: monotonic_ns within one proven shared host clock domain
measurement.cross_host: Do not subtract clocks from different hosts; use local request durations and causal receipt brackets
measurement.polling: State transition time is interval-censored between observations
measurement.gpu: Lease wall time is not kernel busy time; CUDA event timing must cover relevant streams and be read after completion
measurement.intrusion: Do not add device-wide synchronization at every sample; record event/fsync/profiler/query costs and frequency
measurement.samples: Sampled memory/utilization maxima are observed lower bounds on actual peaks, not exhaustive safety evidence
measurement.overlap: Use union of intervals before intersection to prevent duplicate overlap accounting
measurement.physics: Keep physical necessary bounds, empirical microbenchmark references and trace-derived schedule references distinct

hypotheses.claim: API admission does not require model readiness; GPU execution does.
hypotheses.falsification: GPU dispatch before valid model readiness, or an identified unnecessary model-readiness barrier on otherwise admissible API submission.
hypotheses.scope: One cold-start observation, not all startup failures

hypotheses.claim: Attempt stages preserve true dependencies and declared resource ownership.
hypotheses.falsification: Stage dependency reversal, overlapping exclusive GPU leases, or declared CPU ownership above budget.
controls: separate declared reservations from hardware samples
hypotheses.scope: Observed complete event trace and declared resource model

hypotheses.claim: Feasible independent CPU work can overlap another job's GPU stage.
hypotheses.falsification: Sustained ready independent work with available budget is held by an unnecessary all-stage barrier.
controls: at least two matched-shape survivor jobs
hypotheses.scope: Capability and observed opportunity, not global throughput optimality

hypotheses.claim: A queue cancellation accepted before dispatch prevents later GPU ownership and yields a terminal receipt.
hypotheses.falsification: A cancelled queued attempt later enters GPU execution or loses its required terminal receipt.
controls: server ordering, not only client send time
hypotheses.scope: One tested cancellation location; running cancellation separate

hypotheses.claim: Effective precision and generation configuration follow the selected policy without silent fallback.
hypotheses.falsification: Silent quantization, requested-as-effective reporting or cross-task plugin state leakage.
controls: native BF16 with declared FP32 exceptions

hypotheses.claim: One accepted attempt commits one result; uncertainty is reconciled under its original identity.
hypotheses.falsification: Duplicate generation for one unmodified intent after an unknown response, without an explicit new attempt.
hypotheses.scope: Observed paths; fault-tolerance claim requires actual fault exercise

hypotheses.claim: A successful artifact is completely validated and externally downloadable with identical identity and bytes.
hypotheses.falsification: Truncation, hash/identity mismatch or successful state without complete validation.
controls: download survivors only under original IDs
preview not accepted as full-file proof
hypotheses.scope: The actual produced artifacts, not perceptual or semantic quality

hypotheses.claim: Task cleanup, service process exit and platform release each have a distinct verifiable receipt.
hypotheses.falsification: Cleanup reports completion while an owned resource survives, or a required receipt is missing.
hypotheses.scope: Current owned resources and visible platform session

comparison_policy.reason: User requires new content for each generation test.
comparison_policy.allowed: Fixed shapes/modality/steps and randomized assignment of new matched content to strategies in future repeated experiments; report residual content confounding.
comparison_policy.forbidden: A speedup claim from two different-content single runs, or treating sum of concurrent stage durations as a measured serial run.
comparison_policy.small_sample: Report all individual samples and ranges; no stable tail quantile or general reliability inference from this exploratory batch.

remaining_gaps: complete model FLOP and memory-traffic counts
